senses.gloss:
Nation,Ⓒs.ⒹrAzwraM, janapadaH, deSaH, vizayaH; (people) lokaH, janAH, prajAH, janatA, janaH, lokaH, deSajanaH-lokaH, deSavAsinaH.
Ⓝ[Nation]al,Ⓒa.ⒹdeSIya, dESika (kI f.), deSya, rAzwrIya, deSa in comp.; ‘n(ational) custom’ deSAcAraH; ‘n(ational) law’ deSaDarmaH; ‘n(ational) calamity’ u-tpAtaH, janapadodDvaMsaH.
Ⓑ
 2 deSABimAnin.
Ⓑ
 3 sAmAnya, sADAraRa (RI f.), sarvajanIna; See General.
Ⓝ[Nation]ality,Ⓒs.ⒹsvadeSABimAnaH.
Ⓑ
 2 deSIyatA, deSodBavatA.
Ⓝ[Nation]ally,Ⓒadv.ⒹsAmA-nyataH, jAtitaH.

Native,Ⓒa.ⒹdeSaja, deSIya, deSodBava, svadeSo-tpanna.
Ⓑ
 2 sahaja, akftrima, nEsargika (kI f.), svaBAvaja; See Natural.
Ⓑ
 3 janmaprApta, janma-sidDa, janma-sva in comp.; ‘n(ative) country’ janmaBUmi f. -deSaH, svavizayaH-rAzwraM; ‘n(ative) place’ janmasTAnaM, utpattisTAnaM.
Ⓔs.ⒹdeSa-vAsin m., deSajaH, deSodBavaH, deSIyajanaH-lokaH.
Ⓝ[Nativ]ity,Ⓒs.Ⓓutpatti f., saMBavaH, udBavaH, jani f.
Ⓑ
 2 janmapatrikA, jAtakaM; ‘cast oneʼs n(ativity)’ jAtakaM nirUp 10; ‘star at oneʼs n(ativity)’ janmanakzatraM; ‘name given at oneʼs n(ativity)’ janmanAma.
Natron,Ⓒs.Ⓓsarji f., sarjikA, sarjikAkzAraH, kApotaH, suKavarcakaH.

Nature,Ⓒs.Ⓓsfzwi f., jagat n., BUmaMqalaM, viSvaM, brahmAMqaM, sargaH.
Ⓑ
 2 mArgaH, rIti f., kramaH, viDiH, niyamaH, DarmaH, sfzwikramaH.
Ⓑ
 3 prakfti f., mAyA, Sakti f., nirmAtrI devatA, AdiSaktiH-mAyA, praDAnaM (according so Sānkhyas).
Ⓑ
 4 prakAraH, rUpaM, jAti f., rItiH, viDA, in comp.
Ⓑ
 5 BAvaH, prakftiH, svaBAvaH, nisargaH, DarmaH, tattvaM, sattvaM, guRaH, prakfti-nisarga-jAti-svaBAvaH saMsidDi f., svarUpaM, svaDarmaH; SIlaM.
Ⓑ
 6 svaBAva or prakfti-guRaH or DarmaH; ‘preperties of n(ature)’ guRatrayaM (sattvaM, rajaH, tamaH); ‘good n(ature)’ sadBAvaH, suSIlaM, sOjanyaM; ‘of this n(ature)’ evaMviDa; ‘by n(ature)’ prakftyA, jAtyA, janmataH, svaBAvataH; ‘blind by n(ature)’ janmAMDa, jAtyaMDa, januzAMDa; ‘functions of n(ature)’ deha-SarIra-DarmaH.
Ⓝ[Natur]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹsvaBAva, SIla, prakfti in comp.
ⓃNatural,Ⓒa.ⒹsvABAvika-nEsargika-sAMsidDika-prAkftika-sAhajika-Otpattika (kI f.), sahaja, svaBAva-nisarga-ja svaBAva-prakfti-sidDa, sva, nija, aMtarBava, aM-tarjAta, prakftisTa; ‘n(atural) enemy’ jAtaSatru sahajAriH; ‘n(atural) enmity’ SASvatikaH viroDaH; oft. ex. by (s.); svaBAva evEza paropakAri-RAm (S. 5) ‘it is n(atural) with the benevolent’.
Ⓑ
 2 yogya, yaTAmArga-nyAya, yukta, ucita.
Ⓑ
 3 svaBAvAnugata, anuloma, prakftyanu-sArin, svaBAvayogya.
Ⓑ
 4 akftrima, akftaka, ayatnakfta, ayatnanirmita; ‘n(atural) cavity’ deva-KAtaM; ‘n(atural) loveliness’ avyAjasOMdaryaM.
Ⓑ
 5 aklizwa, ayatnakfta, sulaBa.
Ⓑ
 6 (Child) gUQaja, anOrasa (sI f.), jAraja, upastrIjAta, vijAta; See Illegltimate.
Ⓑ
 7 satya, yaTArTa, sarala, akftrima, prakfta.
Ⓑ
 8 yaTAkAlaH ‘n(atural) death’ [] yaTAkAlaM maraRaM; ‘n(atural) day’ sAvana-dinaM; ‘n(atural) form’ svarUpaM; ‘n(atural) disposition’ svaBAvaH, janmasvaBAvaH; ‘n(atural) history’ jaqAjaqa-SAstraM, sTAvarajaMgamaSAstraM; ‘n(atural) philosophy’ padArTavijYAnaM; ‘n(atural) to’ sulaBa; ‘levity n(atural) to mortals’ mAnuzatAsulaBo laGimA (Ka. 134).
Ⓔs.ⒹmUQaH, mUrKaH, jaqaH.
Ⓝ[Natural]ist,Ⓒs.ⒹpadArTa-SAstrajYaH, padArTavijYAnin m.
Ⓝ[Natural]ize,Ⓒv. t.ⒹaByas 4 U; See Familiarize.
Ⓑ
 2 deSIya a. kf 8 U.
Ⓝ[Natural]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹprakftyA, nisargeRa, svaBAvataH, svaBAvena, nisargataH, jAtyA, (s.) in comp.; ‘n(aturally) charming’ nisargamaDura, prakftisuBaga, avyAjasuMdara-manohara, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 yaTAkramaM, anu-lomaM, sfzwikramAnusAreRa.
Ⓑ
 3 akftrimaM, aklizwaM, ayatnataH, sahajaSaktyA-gatyA.
Ⓑ
 4 svataH, svayaM, aMtaHpravfttyA, abalAt, sahajAvaboDena.
Ⓑ
 5 avaSyaM, nirvivAdaM, niyataM, anAyAsenEva; nUnaM, Kalu.
Ⓝ[Natural]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsahajatvaM, akftakatA, yATArTyaM, &c.
